maya: Quick sketch: 'mirror-then-pin' onboarding flow for catalog migrations. Goal: avoid surprise regressions while keeping billing predictable. Plan: mirror candidate responses for live comparison + run golden-prompt evals; only flip routing after combined gates pass.

alex: How is mirror different from canary?

maya: Mirror = send request to candidate in parallel but never expose candidate output to end-user until flip. We keep pinned model response as canonical.

jorge: Proposal for pilot thresholds: golden acceptability delta >= -0.02, hallucination delta <= +1.0%, p95 latency delta <= +130ms. Require passing both golden and sampled-live windows for 3 consecutive checks (4h windows).

sasha: Billing: exclude mirrored responses from billing by tagging router logs mirror=true. If downstream workflow opts to use candidate output explicitly, mark and bill separately. Dedicated tenants get a console opt-in.

evan: Ramp schedule idea: mirror 0% -> 10% probe sampling (no billing) for 48h -> 25% sampling for 48h -> consider flip. Sampling here only controls live-sample fraction for evaluation, not user-facing traffic.

maya: Audit + safety: record initiator, reason, dataset versions (golden set id), customer opt-outs, and a runbook link. Add an SRE kill-switch API to stop mirroring and immediate rollback.

jorge: Dashboards: synthetic vs live split; one-pass/fail badge per metric + time series. I'll version golden sets in KV with a checksum.

alex: Infra tasks: (1) router mirror flag + response tagging (2) webhook to eval service to post results (3) kill-switch endpoint. Estimate 3 dev days.

sasha: Billing tasks: mirror-exclusion flag in billing pipeline + console opt-in toggle for private tenants. Estimate 2 dev days.

ops-bot: job queued: mirror-then-pin-1732468000 - orchestration created.

maya: Rollback triggers: (A) any gate breach sustained across 2 windows, (B) customer-visible error spike >0.1% of requests, (C) manual SRE stop.

evan: For models pinned by a tenant, require explicit tenant opt-in before any flip. For public models, default to opt-out and notify impacted customers 72h before flip.

maya: Deliverables: PR with spec + example config, staging prototype, dashboard prototype, billing change. Owners: jorge (dashboards/orchestration), alex (infra), sasha (billing), evan (tenant opt-in policy), maya (spec/comms). Target: staging prototype in 8 business days.

jorge: I'll start golden prompt curation and a short README for the pattern.

sasha: I'll add billing tasks to next sprint.

maya: Thanks — opening the PR now and tagging owners. :thumbsup:
